title: Cardinality of a subset plus its complement
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $M$ be a subset of the $n$-element index set $\mathrm{Fin}\,n = \{0, 1, \dots, n-1\}$. Then the size of $M$ and the size of its complement $M^c = \mathrm{Fin}\,n \setminus M$ add up to $n$: \[ \abs{M} + \abs{M^c} = n. \]
hypotheses_covered: M is a subset (finset) of the n-element type Fin n
